title: Monday, 9am: Route 7
about: Steps for DEMO_MODE, in the order of the 3-minute script (PRD 1 section 5). Each reply goes through the same inbound path as a real iMessage. After editing a text, record the model answers again: python -m app.services.demo record

steps.text: Otra vez no pasó el autobús de la ruta 7. Esperamos en la parada casi una hora.
steps.say: A Spanish reply arrives. The label and evidence quote appear, and the Route 7 cluster lights up: the third household to say the bus never came.

steps.text: She went with me to court for the custody hearing, the judge wanted to talk to her.
steps.say: A reply the model labels as an appointment. At this school, court dates for family matters count as a family obligation.

steps.label: caregiving or family obligation
steps.say: Maria corrects the label to caregiving or family obligation. (Or do it by hand on the case page.)

steps.text: He came to court with me for the custody hearing, the judge wanted to talk to him.
steps.say: The next similar reply comes back right, and the case page cites Maria's correction.

steps.text: Zoe says an older kid at the bus stop keeps pushing her and taking her lunch. She is scared to go to school.
steps.say: A safety disclosure. It goes straight to the counselor, the on-call counselor is paged, and no automatic reply is sent.
